note: Scenario definitions, not selection results. For recommendation cases, expose the installed descriptions and activation policies for pr-digest, pr-review-round, pr-teacher, pr-detail, release-brief, and any available single-PR review skill. Do not preload workflow bodies or force pr-digest because this file owns the case. Recommend a workflow without invoking it. Keep manual-only host policies enabled. The explicit /pr-digest case may load its body and required explain-to companion; use isolated forge doubles and local output only. Record the actual model, client/version, mode, skill loads, and tool trace before claiming an evaluation result.

evals.name: select-open-inventory
evals.prompt: Which installed skill fits this task: show everything sitting open against main in acme/widgets, including drafts, grouped by workstream? I want the backlog as it stands, not a date range. Recommend the skill and mode only; do not run it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-digest in open-PR inventory mode, including drafts without a time window. Explains that the manual-only workflow needs explicit invocation rather than running it.
assertions: Selects pr-digest inventory rather than a queue review or shipped-period recap
Keeps drafts and older open PRs in scope without asking for a period
Does not invoke a manual-only skill or make external writes

evals.name: select-backlog-health-not-closure
evals.prompt: Which skill should I invoke to see what's in flight on main, which old drafts are still alive, and what we could close? I want an inventory with recommendations, not code reviews or actual closures. Do not run anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-digest inventory with backlog-health checks. Treats possible closures as recommendations, not authority to close PRs or tickets.
assertions: Selects pr-digest inventory even without an explicit date or the word digest
Distinguishes backlog health from code-review verdicts and closure mutations
Does not invoke workflows, close PRs, or change tickets

evals.name: select-shipped-period-recap
evals.prompt: Which skill fits a themed recap of every PR merged to staging last week, with a separate snapshot of PRs ready for review? I want to catch up on development, not verify production deployment. Recommend only; do not run it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-digest merged-plus-ready-for-review mode. Keeps the merged date window separate from the live open snapshot and does not substitute a production release brief.
assertions: Selects pr-digest recap rather than inventory-only, review-round, or release-brief
Applies last week's window to merged PRs, not to the live ready-for-review snapshot
Does not invoke a manual-only workflow or equate merged with deployed

evals.name: reject-one-pr-review
evals.prompt: I need a code review of PR 42 for correctness and blockers before merge, not a walkthrough or a retrospective. Which workflow should I use? Recommend only; do not start the review.
evals.expected_output: Recommends an available single-PR review workflow or direct review if none exists. Does not select the digest, queue round, teacher, or process retrospective.
assertions: Routes to single-PR review without inventing an installed skill
Does not select pr-digest, pr-review-round, pr-teacher, or pr-detail
Does not invoke workflows or post reviews

evals.name: reject-queue-assessment
evals.prompt: Which workflow should I invoke to review every non-draft PR targeting main and tell me which are ready to merge? I need findings verified in the code, not a list of what's open. No posting or merging. Recommend only.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-review-round in assessment-only mode, not pr-digest inventory. Keeps review, dismissal, merge, and publication authority absent.
assertions: Selects pr-review-round assessment rather than pr-digest inventory
Does not treat readiness assessment as authority to post, dismiss, merge, or publish
Does not invoke a manual-only workflow

evals.name: reject-queue-mutations
evals.prompt: Which skill should I invoke to work through the review queue on main, post verified reviews, and merge what's ready? Do not dismiss anyone's review. Recommend only; I am not asking you to start this run yet.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-review-round, not pr-digest. Identifies the requested review/merge scope and excluded dismissals without treating recommendation as execution authority.
assertions: Selects pr-review-round for queue review and merge rather than an inventory or recap
Preserves the no-dismissal boundary and the requirement to verify findings before mutations
Does not invoke workflows or perform forge writes during recommendation

evals.name: reject-single-pr-teaching
evals.prompt: Which skill should I use to understand PR 42, operate an example of its mechanism, and quiz myself on it? I am not asking for a merge verdict. Recommend only.
evals.expected_output: Recommends pr-teacher, not a digest, review round, or process retrospective. Does not invoke the manual-only workflow.
assertions: Selects pr-teacher rather than pr-digest, pr-review-round, or pr-detail
Distinguishes teaching from a correctness or merge-readiness verdict
Does not invoke workflows or make external writes

evals.name: manual-inventory-includes-old-drafts
evals.prompt: /pr-digest inventory acme/widgets against main. Use a light pass, include every open PR, and prepare the HTML locally without publishing. The forge fixture contains PR 10, a 90-day-old draft, and PR 11, a ready-for-review PR opened yesterday; no other open PRs exist. No tracker is available. Do not close, approve, or merge anything.
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit invocation for a no-window inventory, includes both PRs, resolves settings through explain-to, discloses missing tracker enrichment, reconciles the rendered set, and keeps the page local.
assertions: Loads pr-digest only after explicit invocation and uses its required explain-to companion
Includes PR 10 and PR 11 without asking for a period or fetching a merged-period set
Reconciles the primary rendered entries against the fetched PR numbers without dropping the old draft
Discloses unavailable tracker enrichment rather than inventing ticket state
Makes no publication, closure, approval, dismissal, or merge call
